limitations.text: This crop use is located within a PULA. Therefore, 3 ADDITIONAL points (for a total of 6 points) of runoff/erosion mitigations must be achieved for this crop use using the Mitigation Menu (https://www.epa.gov/pesticides/mitigation-menu).

source: EPA Bulletins Live! Two data services at blt.epa.gov (informational, not a Bulletin)
